My dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939),
The mistakes about Walsingham & Sidney had perhaps better be mentioned in the preface to disarm the critics, and that unlucky Amen must be made an erratum it is so ridiculous in its present position.[^1]
Would you notify this to [Clay](/organisation/173), as I do not know the page.
What do you say to the [story of Indian Life](/topic/202) I sent you? If you cannot do any thing with it, please write to me before returning it, for I think I shall ask [Mr Warne](/person/1433) to look at it, and it is a pity it should travel 140 miles between Nos 15 and 16[^2]

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Endorsed ‘Routledge attending to this’. These anachronisms were noted in the preface to [The Chaplet of Pearls](/book/69).
[^2]: Frederick Warne (1825-1901), publisher, had offices at 15 Bedford Street, next door to Macmillan.
